android.desc:
SUZUKI CONNECT will make your car experience more convenient and reassuring.

◆App Features
You can check the remaining fuel level and other information at a glance on the home screen, check the parking location of your car from a remote place, and receive notifications based on the status of your car.

◆Functions

 - Status Notification
Status Notifications tell you when you have left the car and gone away without locking the door or have forgotten to turn off the headlamps or hazard lamps.

 - Parked Car Locator
You do not have to wander around looking for your parked car ever again.
You can easily find and return to your parked car with the app, which shows the location on the map where the engine last stopped.
This is particularly useful in locations with large car parks such as shopping malls or motorway service areas. *1

 - Driving History
Checking the daily driving history for the past 18 months. Displays driving information such as departure/arrival point, time, driving time, and distance you travelled. The data can also be exported as a CSV file.

 - Warning Light Notification
If a warning light turns on due to an issue with the car, you will receive a notification on your smartphone.
The app will indicate the cause of the issue and advise you of recommended action.
You can then use the app to call a dealer directly or ask for roadside assistance. *2

 - Geofencing / Curfew Alert
If another driver is using the car, Geofencing notifies you when the car leaves or enters a set area during a set time period.
Curfew Alerts notify you when the car is absent from a set area after a set time.

 - Support
You can search for or call a SUZUKI Dealer near you.

 - Security Notifications
A Security Notification will appear on your smartphone if the security alarm is activated or if the engine is started while you are not using the car.

 - Periodic maintenance/recall notification
To make sure your car’s periodic maintenance is done on time, you will receive a reminder as the deadline is approaching.
Also you will receive a notification if your car becomes subject to a recall or service campaign.

 - For EVs Only
*Some functions are not available depending on the vehicle model.

‐Reservation Charging
You can schedule charging start and end times from your smartphone.

quotes.text:
I've used a 2023 Suzuki S-Cross (manual fwiw) and this doesn't match my experience. Which model are you using?

They have an app [0] (which doesn't sync correctly for me, and their support is awful). When working it shows things like where you last parked, fuel efficiency, and allows you to remotely lock the vehicle, so it has internet access.

I sent Suzuki a Subject Access Request as a workaround to gain access to the data, and received months of extremely accurate location, speed, etc data.

There are also software updates, you just have to do them yourself [1]. They also didn't work for me.

Software aside however, they are extremely reliable cars, most of which seems down to their simplicity.

[0]: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=suzuki.app.a025.SzkCnnctEur

[1]: https://www.infotainment-system.com/en/device/summary
